environment.description: Application deployed on an EC2 instance behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer) in a private VPC subnet. Access is provided via AWS PrivateLink to partner accounts. The NLB performs TCP passthrough on port 443 with TLS termination at the application (nginx reverse proxy to Flask). Security group allows inbound TCP/443 from the VPC CIDR 10.0.0.0/8. No application-layer filtering is applied at any network hop. SQLite database is local on EBS volume. Flask runs as app user with standard permissions.
